compound_note: No gap between compounds this year (2025 ran C2 hard). The hard is softer, so it is a real race option rather than a tyre teams avoid.
plan_detail: Pit around lap 30 (top-10 runners stopped between laps 28 and 34).
quali_note: Qualifying matters, but winners do come from the second and third rows, so a strong race car can recover.
alt_note: Recently, one-stoppers gained more places on average (+1.1 vs +0.0).

compound_note: One step softer than 2025, when the hard was barely raced and most teams two-stopped on the softer tyres. Expect more stops, possibly all three compounds.
quali_note: Track position is everything here: qualifying decides most races, so an undercut is the main way to gain places.

compound_note: Cold track temperatures make tyre warm-up, not wear, the main problem.
plan_detail: Pit around lap 22 (top-10 runners stopped between laps 19 and 26).
quali_note: Every winner here has started from the front row (3 races so far), though not always from pole. Qualifying in the top two matters more than pole itself.
alt_note: Recently, one-stoppers gained more places on average (+1.3 vs +1.0).

compound_note: In 2023 and 2025 a maximum stint length was imposed for tyre safety, which forced extra stops. Check whether a limit applies again.
plan_detail: Recent Qatar races had a mandatory maximum stint length, so stop timing was set by the rule. If a limit applies again, plan stops to the limit; without one, two stops is the expected plan.
quali_note: Qualifying matters, but winners do come from the second and third rows, so a strong race car can recover.

compound_note: Low degradation track; a one-stop is usually fastest.

quali_note: Track position is everything here: qualifying decides most races, so an undercut is the main way to gain places.
